items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: The interviewee confirms the spelling of 'John Veen' but the subsequent conversation is about the interviewee's father, not John Veen. No personal interaction or relationship between Arthur Vigne and John Veen is described.

ctx.x: How was his first name spelled? Just regular John? John. J-O-H-N. John. Because some people would spell it like a French, J-E-A-N or something like a French spelling. I've seen it that way.
Just regular John. John Veen, that's how he was known.
If you don't mind to tell us as much as you can remember about your father. Do you remember when he was born, about what year and when he died? Those facts. We don't even know that.
